summary: Implemented the TimeElapsedColumn feature in the rich repository without committing. Changes: rich/progress.py (TimeElapsedColumn, Task.finished_time field, finished property, _reset clearing, capture in update and advance, clear in reset); rich/default_styles.py (progress.elapsed yellow); rich/palette.py (Palette.__rich__ with lazy imports); CHANGELOG.md (Unreleased Added entry); tests/test_palette.py (new test_rich_cast); tests/test_progress.py (test_time_elapsed_column added, TimeElapsedColumn added to test_columns, expected output regenerated by hand-trace). Tests were NOT run, per instructions. The test_columns expected output was derived by tracing clock reads and checked for bar widths (25 and 16) and 80-column row widths. Interpretation: a running column makes two clock reads (shared base read plus elapsed). Table headers chosen as Index, RGB, Color.
